tiktok.body: Comment “YC” and I’ll send you the full Summer 2026 list. Twice a year, Y Combinator publishes the startups it wants founders to build. It’s the best signal in the game — so I pulled the 4 that match my thesis. The theme: AI is done being a feature. It’s the foundation now — and it’s leaving the screen for the physical world. 	1.	AI-native services — don’t sell the software, be the firm. Own the work, own the data, own the margin. 	2.	Electronics in space — inference chips built for orbit. 	3.	Hardware supply chain — close the gap between a design and a finished part. 	4.	Industrial capabilities in space — yes, mining the moon. Three of my four picks aren’t software. Chips, factories, and the moon. The last decade rewarded companies that lived on the internet. The next rewards the ones building in the real world. If you like this kind of thing — join our community Frontier.
